items.title: Pay disputed 'lottery subscription' collection claim
items.quote: Überweisen Sie den Gesamtbetrag innerhalb von 72 Stunden, spätestens bis 06.08.2026, ausschließlich auf folgendes Treuhandkonto: IBAN LT71 7300 0101 2345 6789, Kontoinhaber: A. Petrauskas, Verwendungszweck EC-DE-2026-481120.
items.computation: The letter prints an explicit calendar deadline ('spätestens bis 06.08.2026') rather than a period to be counted; a printed calendar date is used as written regardless of weekday. No adjustment for weekends/holidays applies since this is a private demand, not a statutory period ending rule, and the date is simply as stated.

warnings: The payment IBAN (LT71 ...) is a Lithuanian account held by a private individual (A. Petrauskas), not a German or company account — a strong indicator this is a fraudulent debt-collection scheme.

The extremely short 72-hour payment deadline combined with threats of immediate 'Kontopfändung', a negative SCHUFA entry and a criminal complaint 'ohne weitere Ankündigung' (without further notice) is a classic high-pressure scam tactic; a private debt collector cannot legally seize a bank account or file a valid criminal complaint on its own authority.

The sentence 'Ein Widerspruch ist zwecklos und verursacht weitere Kosten' is legally false and appears designed to discourage the recipient from exercising their right to object — this is itself a major red flag of fraud and should be disregarded.

The underlying claim is said to arise from a 'telefonisch abgeschlossenen Gewinnspiel-Abonnement' (a lottery/gaming subscription supposedly agreed by phone), a well-known pattern used in subscription-trap and cold-call fraud schemes; verify whether any such contract was ever actually concluded before considering any payment.
The sender is based in Cyprus with no verifiable German business registration or address, making it difficult to confirm legitimacy or pursue recourse.
The stated payment deadline (06.08.2026) has already passed relative to today's date (2026-09-25), which is inconsistent and suggests either an old or fabricated letter.

Do not pay this claim or use the provided IBAN without independently verifying the debt and the sender's legitimacy, ideally via consumer protection services (e.g. Verbraucherzentrale) before taking any action.
